60 packages your web app can call today. Add a package to your app in the console, then call it as shown. Each name links to the package's sample, its actions, results and events. Packages marked Alpha can still change.

## Sign-in

- [Clerk (Auth)](/packages/clerk#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.auth.clerk.status()`. Add sign-in, sign-up and account screens to your app with Clerk.
- [Sign in with Apple (Auth)](/packages/apple#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.auth.apple.signIn(…)`. Let people sign in to your app with their Apple ID.
- [Sign-in](/packages/auth#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.auth.signIn(…)`. Add sign-in to your app with one set of screens and actions, whichever service holds the account.

## Payments & subscriptions

- [In-app purchases and paywalls](/packages/store#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.store.purchase(…)`. Sell subscriptions and purchases with a native paywall and one simple way to check what a user owns.
- [Payments](/packages/payments#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.payments.payment(…)`. Take payments in your app with one set of calls, whichever payment provider you use.
- [RevenueCat (Store)](/packages/revenuecat#use-it): `await dsx.module.store.revenuecat.login(…)`. Sell subscriptions and in-app purchases with RevenueCat.
- [Stripe (Payments)](/packages/stripe#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.payments.stripe.payment(…)`. Take card, Apple Pay and bank payments with Stripe.

## Notifications

- [Firebase Cloud Messaging](/packages/firebase#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.firebase.app()`. Send push notifications to your app's users through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
- [OneSignal (Notify)](/packages/onesignal#use-it): `await dsx.module.notify.onesignal.login(…)`. Send push notifications to your app's users through OneSignal.
- [Push notifications](/packages/notify#use-it): `await dsx.module.notify.schedule(…)`. Receive and show push and local notifications in your app without a third-party push SDK.

## Device & sensors

- [Bluetooth](/packages/bluetooth#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.bluetooth.connect(…)`. Connect your app to nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices.
- [Clipboard](/packages/clipboard#use-it): `await dsx.module.clipboard.read(…)`. Read from and write to the system clipboard, with a way to peek without triggering the paste alert.
- [Contacts](/packages/contacts#use-it): `await dsx.module.contacts.get(…)`. Let users share a contact, or read and edit the address book.
- [Face ID and Touch ID](/packages/biometric#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.biometric.authenticate(…)`. Confirm it is really the user with Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode.
- [Haptics](/packages/haptic#use-it): `await dsx.module.haptic.success()`. Add vibration feedback to taps and results.
- [Location](/packages/geo#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.geo.bearing(…)`. Get the user's location, track movement and trigger geofences.
- [Motion sensors](/packages/motion#use-it): `await dsx.module.motion.start(…)`. Read accelerometer, gyroscope, steps and activity from the device.
- [NFC card emulation (NFC)](/packages/hce#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.nfc.hce.status()`. Let an Android phone answer NFC readers as a card.
- [NFC tags](/packages/nfc#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.nfc.scan(…)`. Read and write NFC tags from your app.
- [Wallet](/packages/wallet#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.wallet.addPasses(…)`. Let people add a boarding pass, ticket or card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.

## Media

- [Camera](/packages/camera#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.camera.start(…)`. Capture photos and video and control a live camera session.

## Analytics & ads

- [App rating](/packages/apprating#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.apprating.request(…)`. Ask the system to show its in-app rating prompt.
- [AppsFlyer (Growth)](/packages/appsflyer#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.growth.appsflyer.start()`. Attribute installs and purchases to ad campaigns with AppsFlyer.
- [Error and crash reporting](/packages/telemetry#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.telemetry.capture(…)`. Report crashes, hangs and errors from your app to the monitoring service you choose.
- [Meta App Events (Growth)](/packages/metaads#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.growth.metaads.send(…)`. Report app events and purchases to Meta ads, match them to people, and open Meta deferred app links.
- [PostHog (Growth)](/packages/growth-modules-posthog#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.growth.posthog.send(…)`. Send your app's analytics events to PostHog.
- [PostHog (Telemetry)](/packages/telemetry-modules-posthog#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.telemetry.posthog.send(…)`. Sends your app's error and crash reports to PostHog.
- [Product analytics](/packages/growth#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.growth.track(…)`. Track what users do in your app and send it to every analytics and ad measurement tool you pick.
- [TikTok Ads (Growth)](/packages/tiktokads#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.growth.tiktokads.start()`. Measure which TikTok ads bring installs and sales, using the TikTok Business SDK.

## Storage

- [Key-value storage](/packages/storage#use-it): `await dsx.module.storage.open()`. Save small settings and values on the device so they are still there next time the app opens.

## Interface

- [Share sheet](/packages/share#use-it): `await dsx.module.share.present(…)`. Let people share text, links and files from your app through the phone's share sheet.

## Health

- [Terra Health (Health)](/packages/terra#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.health.terra.connect(…)`. Pull Apple Health and wearable data into your app through Terra.

## More

- [ActionSheet](/packages/actionsheet#use-it): `await dsx.module.actionsheet.show(…)`. Show the system's own action sheet and find out which option the user picked.
- [AgeAssurance](/packages/ageassurance#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.ageassurance.check(…)`. Ask the phone's operating system for the user's age range.

- [DeviceUUID](/packages/uuid#use-it): `await dsx.module.uuid.get()`. Gives your app a stable anonymous id for each install, with no permission prompt.
- [Dom](/packages/dom#use-it): `await dsx.module.dom.set(…)`. Control the web view that shows your web app: load pages, navigate, run scripts.
- [FileSharing](/packages/filesharing#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.filesharing.openIn(…)`. Open a file from your app in another app.
- [FileUpload](/packages/fileupload#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.fileupload.captureInfo(…)`. Make file inputs in your web pages open the camera, photo library, scanner or file picker.
- [FileViewer](/packages/fileviewer#use-it): `await dsx.module.fileviewer.preview(…)`. Preview PDFs, images and documents in a native viewer.
- [Flashlight](/packages/flashlight#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.flashlight.set(…)`. Turn the device flashlight on and off.
- [Health](/packages/health#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.health.read(…)`. Read and write Apple Health and Android Health Connect data.
- [IdentityVault](/packages/identityvault#use-it): `await dsx.module.identityvault.read(…)`. Stores small secrets on the device in the system keychain, with an optional Face ID or fingerprint lock.
- [Language](/packages/language#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.language.get()`. Read and set the app language.
- [Nearby](/packages/nearby#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.nearby.start(…)`. Connect two phones running your app directly and send them data, with no server.
- [OAuth](/packages/oauth#use-it): `await dsx.module.oauth.start(…)`. Sign users in with Google, Apple, GitHub or any other OAuth provider in the system sign-in sheet.
- [Parental Consent (AgeAssurance)](/packages/parentalconsent#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.ageassurance.parentalconsent.ask(…)`. Ask a parent to approve a significant app update.
- [PreventDefault (Dom)](/packages/preventdefault#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.dom.preventdefault.autoscroll(…)`. Control keyboard-driven layout adjustment.
- [PrintDocuments](/packages/print#use-it): `await dsx.module.print.capabilities(…)`. Print a PDF or other document through the system print sheet.
- [PullToRefresh (Dom)](/packages/pulltorefresh#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.dom.pulltorefresh.set(…)`. Let people pull down on a web page in your app to reload it.
- [QuickActions](/packages/quickactions#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.quickactions.get()`. Add shortcuts to your app icon's long-press menu on the Home screen.
- [Scanner](/packages/scanner#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.scanner.scan(…)`. Scan QR codes, barcodes and paper documents with the camera.
- [SpeechRecognition](/packages/speechrecognition#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.speechrecognition.start(…)`. Turn the user's speech into text with the standard web speech API.
- [SpeechSynthesis](/packages/speechsynthesis#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.speechsynthesis.start(…)`. Speaks text aloud with the device voices, or turns text into audio files.
- [Spinner](/packages/spinner#use-it) (Alpha): `await dsx.module.spinner.show(…)`. Show or hide an activity indicator over the app.
- [SystemBars](/packages/systembars#use-it): `await dsx.module.systembars.set(…)`. Control the status bar and the navigation bar from your screens.
- [WebSocket](/packages/websocket#use-it): `await dsx.module.websocket.connect(…)`. Connect to a WebSocket server and receive its messages as call events.
